article.story: WASHINGTON -- — Vincent Iwuchukwu scored 29 points as Georgetown beat Coppin State 84-60 on Saturday. Iwuchukwu had 10 rebounds for the Hoyas (6-0). Elmarko Jackson scored 19 points, going 6 of 11 from the floor, including 1 for 3 from 3-point range, and 6 for 6 from the line. Jaland Lowe went 6 of 16 from the field (1 for 5 from 3-point range) to finish with 15 points. Nelson Lamizana led the Eagles (1-6) in scoring, finishing with 15 points. Tafara Gapare added 13 points for Coppin State. Baasil Saunders finished with 10 points and two steals. Georgetown took the lead for good with 13:48 remaining in the first half. The score was 49-37 at halftime, with Iwuchukwu scoring 19 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
